title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v104
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: bring profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and an improved reporting pipeline into the benchmark-lab repo to support the V2 performance dashboard and more accurate regression detection. This PR consolidates previous ad-hoc runners, adds stable profiling baselines for cold/warm start scenarios, and wires the aggregated results into the reporting pipeline used by the dashboard and nightly alerts.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a set of representative workload runners (chat, completion, embedding, rerank) with configurable load profiles and warm/cold start toggles.
- Introduces profiling baselines (cold/warm, p50/p95/p99 token latencies, memory footprints) for common model families and sequence lengths.
- Implements reporting pipeline v104: ingestion + normalization + BigQuery export + dashboard-friendly JSON artifacts.
- Adds CI jobs to run smoke workloads on PRs and nightly profiling job orchestration.

Checklist:
- [x] Representative runners implemented and unit tested
- [x] Profiling baseline definitions and golden files added
- [x] Reporting pipeline ETL + BigQuery export wired up
- [x] Nightly profiler cron job and gating alerts configured
- [x] Docs: README and runbook updated with migration notes

Why this change: accurate and stable baselines reduce false-positive regressions and make rollouts safer. Centralized reporting enables per-route/model dashboards and automatic regression alerts.

Migration notes: existing nightly tasks should be switched to the new cron name `benchlab-profiling-nightly-v2` in the deployment config. The BigQuery table schema was extended (see README); backward compatibility is preserved for older dashboard versions via a compatibility layer in reporting/compat.py.

Related: Linear ENG-1284 (profiling baselines), PM-342 (dashboard metrics), SUP-921 (customer incident requiring clearer cold-start metrics).
commits_summary: 6 commits: initial runners and baseline schema, add ETL + BigQuery export, CI jobs and smoke tests, fix flaky runner scheduling, add docs and runbook, final cleanups and test fixes.
review_conversation:
Evan: Asked for stronger isolation between runners to avoid cross-contamination of KV caches; requested explicit cache flush before cold-run lines.
Author (Aisha): Implemented per-run sandboxing and added cache flush; pushed fix in commit 4.
Marcus: Noted the ETL relied on a legacy helper that could drop nulls silently; requested defensive checks and unit tests.
Author: Added defensive validation and a test that simulates missing fields; updated pipeline to log and continue with partial data.
Priya: Verified CI smoke jobs and asked to throttle nightly job if cluster utilization > 80% to avoid interference with Dedicated customers.
Author: Added autoscaling-aware throttle using the existing cluster-summary API and documented behavior in runbook.
Final: Marcus approved after test additions, Evan approved after cache isolation verification, Priya gave the final approval post-throttling change.
Merge: Squash-merged by Marcus Chen after all approvals and CI green.
ci_checks: CI summary: unit tests passed (pytest 342s), integration tests (ETL) passed on staging run, lint (pre-commit) passed, smoke profiling job ran successfully in ephemeral infra. One flaky test (test_runners:test_cold_start) was fixed in commit 5. Nightly profiling job configuration validated by infra pipeline. All checks green on final run.
merge_outcome: merged (squash) by Marcus Chen on 2025-03-01 after approvals from Evan Li and Priya Nair. Changelog updated and release notes attached.
release_notes: Added profiling baselines v2 and reporting pipeline v104 for benchmark-lab: stable representative workload runners, nightly profiling job, BigQuery export for dashboards, and runbook. No breaking changes expected; migrate nightly cron name as documented.
notes_for_release: DB schema extended; dashboard owners should point to the new BigQuery table `benchmark_lab.profile_baselines_v104` or use the compatibility layer in reporting/compat.py. Nightly job renamed—update deployment config if you rely on the old name.
testing_and_rollout: Staged rollout: library and runners deployed to canary infra for 48h, then promoted to staging for full ETL validation. Nightly job ran for three cycles with stable outputs before merge. Alert thresholds for regressions set to p95 + 15% and validated against baselines.
backout_plan: If the reporting pipeline causes ingestion errors, revert pipeline_v104 config in infra and re-enable pipeline_v103. For regressions in nightly profiler, disable cron and revert runners package to tag `v103` while debugging.
impact_summary: Improves regression detection fidelity and reduces noise for perf alerts. Adds 1x nightly job and modest CI time; no customer-facing API changes.
